text:
tara (CFO): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: runway and spend controls. Current baseline runway ~12.7 months. posting the Q&A thread here for action items.
kevin (CEO): Thanks Tara. Any delta vs last month and what's driving it?
tara (CFO): Delta is +1.5% month-over-month burn due to contractor ramp and cloud transient costs. We're modeling a small optimization plan to get back to baseline.
lee (eng): For cloud costs: is there a required review cadence for teams?
omar (finance): Requesting all infra/product teams do a monthly cost review and submit a short form if >10% change month-over-month. We'll link the form in #finance-docs.
ash (procure-bot): Reminder: PO workflow enforced for one-off vendor spends > $8k and for recurring contracts that annualize > $8k. P-card is OK under $2.5k with manager approval.
ash (procure-bot): (automated) Link to PO template: https://internal.docs/po-template
ash (procure-bot): (automated) If you need an exception, tag #finance with reason + dollar amount.
ash (procure-bot): (automated) To submit vendor addition, use VendorForm v2.
ash (procure-bot): :white_check_mark:
ash (procure-bot): :lock: Vendor legal checks required for data-processed vendors.
ash (procure-bot): :hourglass_flowing_sand: Expect 48-72h for finance approval on PO requests.
ash (procure-bot): :information_source: Emergencies escalate to tara + kevin.
ash (procure-bot): :link: https://internal.docs/vendor-onboarding
ash (procure-bot): :package: Contract playbook: short exceptions allowed for infra emergencies < $15k with ops lead + finance pre-approval.
lee (eng): For hiring: are teams allowed backfills?
Nina (people-ops): We're allowing mission-critical backfills only. People-ops and the hiring manager must submit a Prioritization form. Template will be in #people-ops.
ash (procure-bot): Note: contractor engagement tiers: up to $6k/month can be approved by manager + recruiting; anything longer or more expensive needs finance approval.
ash (procure-bot): For recurring SaaS > $1k/month procurement needs vendor review.
ash (procure-bot): :memo: Save receipts and upload to Expensify within 7 days.
ash (procure-bot): :balance_scale: Reminder: discounts and credits from vendors must be cleared with finance to ensure revenue recognition is handled correctly.
ash (procure-bot): :chart_with_downwards_trend: If a team plans to increase cloud spend >20% next month, run it by eng-infra + finance 5 business days prior.
jules (sre): We saw a big cost spike from a nightly test cluster. Any fast wins?
tara (CFO): Short wins: stop nightly clusters not used for 24h, enable autosuspend, and evaluate reserved instances where applicable. We'll share a short playbook.
ash (procure-bot): :bulb: Suggested tag keys: cost-center, team, project, env. Tagging helps us allocate spend.
ash (procure-bot): :date: Deadline: please tag your resources by EOD Friday.
lee (eng): ack, will start tagging.
ash (procure-bot): Action items summary: [1] teams tag resources (cost-center/team/project) by EOD Friday; [2] submit infra rightsizing list by next Wed; [3] hiring backfills: people-ops + prioritization form; [4] exceptions: tag #finance with rationale.
tara (CFO): I'll post the model workbook + scenario slides in #finance-docs in 30m and a short FAQ. If anyone wants a 1:1 walkthrough of the model, book time with omar.
kevin (CEO): Good. Let's prioritize quick tooling and tagging so we get visibility. thanks all. :thumbsup:
